facts.fact: Greg 晚归，双手掩面抱怨 lord mayor 要求保证 Ungo.com 不干扰 ley lines、还要请测量员核对图表，谈判不顺。
facts.anchor: He wants assurances that Ungo.com™ isn’t going to interfere with any ley lines. He wants to bring in a surveyor to check the charts!

facts.fact: 出发进村前，Molly 在后门台阶放了一小碟牛奶，解释说是喂给 Round Robin 的一小口。
facts.anchor: “It’s a little nibble for Round Robin,” she explained.

facts.fact: Jessica 用最温和的口气问 Molly 是否真信这类事，Molly 脸红了，回答最好求个安稳，尤其在 Tigglestide 前后。
facts.anchor: “I think it’s best to be safe, especially around Tigglestide,” said Molly.

facts.fact: 进村遇到养蜂人 Mr. Bumblesnatch：大汉头戴巨大编织藤篮看不见脸，隔着篮子用尖细如孩童的嗓音向 Molly 和 Jessica 问好，并预告今年 Tigglestide 蜂蜜会有好收成。
facts.anchor: “Thank you, Molly!” said a squeaky, childlike voice from within the wicker basket

facts.fact: 糖果店主 Mr. Cherrywood 走出店门给围在橱窗外的学童每人发一颗太妃糖，孩子们欢呼 “Three cheers” 为他喝彩。
facts.anchor: “Three cheers for Mr. Cherrywood!” they shouted.

facts.fact: 果酱店里满脸煤烟、收起酒壶的烟囱工 Pip 认出 Jessica 是美国人，连声说她不该在这里、不是“对的那种人”。
facts.anchor: “Leave. ’Ello, guvna. You shouldn’t be ’ere. ’T-tain’t right! ’Ello, guvna! I can tell, you ain’t the right sort! ’Ello, guvna!”

facts.fact: Pip 用肮脏的手抓住 Jessica 手臂，说见过她那紫头发的孩子、Round Robin 不会容许，又警告 Round Robin 会把她毁掉，随后瘫回椅子里摸出酒壶再喝。
facts.anchor: Mark my words, guvna! Round Robin will bring ye to ruin, guvna!

facts.fact: 晚餐上 Greg 沮丧离席，Jessica 追问 Sandy 是否真觉得不安全，被 “I use it for my practice” 顶回；她没有把烟囱工的威胁告诉 Sandy，只自我安慰那不过是醉鬼醉话。
facts.anchor: It was probably nothing to worry about. Nothing to worry about at all.
